verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents per-campaign email reports with open and click rates and per-link click counts. Campaign ROI is covered through e-commerce tracking, and Analytics AI names campaigns and automations that drive revenue. Missing for 10: documented unsubscribe metrics in campaign reports, per-automation-step breakdowns, time-series/trend views of these metrics, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can read opens, clicks, unsubscribes, and conversions per campaign and per automation step, over time

citations.quote: Your Mailchimp tracking reports include open and click rates, which measure your recipients' engagement with your subject lines and email content.
your email report will show which recipients clicked your links and how many times each link was clicked.
turn on e-commerce tracking to measure campaign ROI.
explains which campaigns and automations are actually moving revenue
